messages:
maya: Heads-up — AWQ/INT8 bakeoff hit a blocker on TensorRT-LLM when deploying to Dedicated A100s. Crash reproducible.

maya: Repro steps: 
```
# launcher we used
trt-llm-server --model /mnt/models/llama-reloaded-70b-awq --batch-size 8 --cuda-major 12 --triton-version 2.7
```

maya: Crash log (truncated):
```
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'
  what():  cuMemcpyAsync failed: out of memory
[trt-llm] ERROR: failed to allocate workspace for attention kernel
```

maya: Context: model was converted from GPTQ -> AWQ using our qconvert v2; accuracy delta looked fine locally (val perplexity +0.9% vs FP16) but production deploy fails.

sam: Which driver + CUDA runtime on the nodes? Triton kernel ABI changes are a common gotcha.

maya: nodes are on driver 535.113, CUDA runtime 12.2, Triton 2.7.0, TensorRT 8.8.1. vLLM tests (CPU / BF16 path) didn't crash.

sam: Hmm. TensorRT-LLM + AWQ uses custom fused kernels that touch cuBLASLt. I think 8.8.1 + CUDA12.2 had a known workspace-size calc change. Could be workspace underalloc.

eli: Also double-check cudnn/tensorrt plugin ABI. We saw similar with INT8 calibrated GPTQ + TensorRT where kernel shape mismatch only surfaced under batch>1.

liam: Quick datapoint from the bakeoff:
- Model: llama-reloaded-70b
- Baseline FP16 ppl (wikitext): 12.8
- GPTQ INT8 ppl: 13.1 (+2.3%)
- AWQ INT8 ppl: 13.0 (+1.6%)
- AWQ FP8 prototype: 12.9 (+0.8%)
These were on a dev box (CUDA 12.1, TRT 8.7). So AWQ accuracy looked better than our GPTQ run in that env.

natalie: If it runs on 12.1 but crashes on 12.2, maybe kernel/reservation changes. Can we reproduce on a single A100 with 12.1 vs 12.2? We should try to bisect driver/runtime.

maya: Will try. Quick note: enabling `--trt-profiles=disable_dynamic_workspace` temporarily avoids the throw but TF fallback kills perf. Not ideal.

sam: Also try the vLLM TRT plugin path — it uses a different memory strategy. If that works, we can route traffic to vLLM path as a fallback while infra patches drivers.

eli: On accuracy/regression side, we observed these patterns across our eval suite (MMLU / Hellaswag / L4) when swapping quant paths:
- GPTQ: median delta -0.4% (small drop)
- AWQ: median delta -0.7% but lower variance
- AWQ+per-channel calib: -0.3% and fewer high-tail regressions
These are noisy; need consistent eval prompt sets.

liam: To add: some AWQ implementations use packed attention kernels that require cuBLASLt >= 12.2 runtime behavior — mismatch yields OOM on workspace compute step. If we lock CUDA runtime to 12.1 + driver 535.101 it might be stable.

maya: Ran quick test on a single node with driver 535.101 + CUDA 12.1 and TRT 8.7 — AWQ INT8 launch succeeded, passed smoke gen, latency within 1.1x of FP16. Will schedule a 2h canary tomorrow.

natalie: Let's track this as a P0 infra compatibility ticket. @infra-bot can you create ticket and attach logs?

infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-4827: "TensorRT-LLM OOM with AWQ INT8 on CUDA12.2" — linked logs + node spec. Assigned to @liam. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-4827 :white_check_mark:

sam: Action items:
- maya: run 12.1 vs 12.2 reproduce matrix (done -> started canary).
- liam: try build of TRT-LLM with cuBLASLt fallback/force-workspace-fit and test.
- eli: run eval suite on 12.1 artifact vs our GPTQ baseline and report MMLU/Hellaswag deltas (include per-prompt fail cases).
- natalie: coordinate canary and rollback plan for Dedicated pool.

maya: One more gotcha discovered: AWQ conversion script produced a metadata flag `quant_block_size=32` which TRT path ignores -> causes layout mismatch for multi-GPU sharding. We should validate conversion metadata checksum in qconvert v2.

liam: Good catch. I'll add a conversion validator to the onboarding checklist.

eli: If anyone needs the raw eval tables I pushed a CSV to /mnt/evals/awq_gptq_bakeoff_1749001123.csv — columns: model,quant,env,driver,cuda,trt,ppl,mmludiff,latency_qps.

maya: Thanks — will attach that CSV to INFRA-4827.

natalie: Let's reconvene after the canary (T+24h). If canary stable, we can promote AWQ path for Dedicated and add runtime guard that forces 12.1-compatible builds.

sam: FYI for the short-term fallback: route heavy latency-sensitive routes to GPTQ variant (slightly worse cost/accuracy) and enable AWQ only for batchy throughput routes.

maya: Sounds good. I'll post results here once canary finishes. :eyes:
